stage: Stage 2 quantum barriers, wells, resonant tunnelling, and LDOS

peak_detection.method: local maxima with a fixed-window prominence estimate

primary_ldos_resonance_selection: highest-transmission detected peak below the barrier-region band edge; central-well LDOS fraction is then measured independently
units: consistent tight-binding energy units with hopping magnitude t=1

conventions.self_energy: Sigma^r=t_c^2*g_s^r at first and last device sites
conventions.device_green_function: G^r=[E I-H_device-Sigma_L-Sigma_R]^-1; no added imaginary shift
conventions.transmission_processing: no normalization; only roundoff-scale negative results within the transmission function tolerance are set to zero
